blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `listAndCountProductOptions` method. This belongs to the Product Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method is used to retrieve a paginated list of product options along with the total count of available product options satisfying the provided filters.

You can only retrieve data models defined in the same module. To retrieve linked data models
from other modules, use [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query) instead.

types.name: config
types.description:
The configurations determining how the product options are retrieved. Its properties, such as `select` or `relations`, accept the
attributes or relations associated with a product option.

children.name: select
children.description: An array of strings, each being attribute names of the entity to retrieve in the result.

children.name: skip
children.description: A number indicating the number of records to skip before retrieving the results.

children.name: take
children.description: A number indicating the number of records to return in the result.

children.name: relations
children.description:
An array of strings, each being relation names of the entity to retrieve in the result.

You can only retrieve data models defined in the same module. To retrieve linked data models
from other modules, use [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query) instead.

children.name: order
children.description:
An object used to specify how to sort the returned records. Its keys are the names of attributes of the entity, and a key's value can either be `ASC`
to sort retrieved records in an ascending order, or `DESC` to sort retrieved records in a descending order.

children.name: withDeleted
children.description:
A boolean indicating whether deleted records should also be retrieved as part of the result. This only works if the entity extends the
`SoftDeletableEntity` class.

types.name: listAndCountProductOptions
types.description: This method is used to retrieve a paginated list of product options along with the total count of available product options satisfying the provided filters.
types.example: To retrieve a list of product options using their IDs:const [options, count] = await productModuleService.listAndCountProductOptions({ id: ["opt_123", "opt_321"], })To specify relations that should be retrieved within the product options: :::note You can only retrieve data models defined in the same module. To retrieve linked data models from other modules, use [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query) instead. :::const [options, count] = await productModuleService.listAndCountProductOptions( { id: ["opt_123", "opt_321"], }, { relations: ["product"], } )By default, only the first`15`records are retrieved. You can control pagination by specifying the`skip`and`take`properties of the`config`parameter:const [options, count] = await productModuleService.listAndCountProductOptions( { id: ["opt_123", "opt_321"], }, { relations: ["product"], take: 20, skip: 2, } )
